# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API — PDF API

> A PDF document is organized as a sequence of pages. Each page can contain several types of content: paragraphs, tables, drawings (images, shapes, charts), annotations, and interactive form fields.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [PDF API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api.md): A PDF document is organized as a sequence of pages. Each page can contain several types of content: paragraphs, tables, drawings (images, shapes, charts), annotations, and interactive form fields.

## Api

- [Api](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api.md): The main class of the PDF API. Use it to get the current document and to create page content, such as paragraphs, tables, images, annotations, and form fields.
- [Api.CentimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CentimetersToPoints.md): Converts centimeters to points.
- [Api.Color](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/Color.md): Creates an ApiColor from a universal input.
- [Api.CreateBlipFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateBlipFill.md): Creates a blip fill to apply to the object using the selected image as the object background.
- [Api.CreateBullet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateBullet.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the character or symbol specified with the sSymbol parameter.
- [Api.CreateButtonField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateButtonField.md): Creates a button field.
- [Api.CreateCaretAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateCaretAnnot.md): Creates caret annotation.
- [Api.CreateChart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateChart.md): Creates a chart with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateCheckboxField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateCheckboxField.md): Creates a checkbox field.
- [Api.CreateCircleAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateCircleAnnot.md): Creates circle annotation.
- [Api.CreateComboboxField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateComboboxField.md): Creates a combobox field.
- [Api.CreateCustomGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateCustomGeometry.md): Creates a new custom geometry.
- [Api.CreateDateField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateDateField.md): Creates a text date field.
- [Api.CreateFreeTextAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateFreeTextAnnot.md): Creates freeText annotation.
- [Api.CreateGoToAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateGoToAction.md): Creates a GoTo action.
- [Api.CreateGradientStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateGradientStop.md): Creates a gradient stop used for different types of gradients.
- [Api.CreateHideShowFormsAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateHideShowFormsAction.md): Creates a hide-show forms action.
- [Api.CreateHighlightAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateHighlightAnnot.md): Creates highlight annotation.
- [Api.CreateImage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateImage.md): Creates an image with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateImageField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateImageField.md): Creates a image field.
- [Api.CreateImageStampAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateImageStampAnnot.md): Creates stamp annotation from an image. The annotation dimensions are taken from the loaded image, or updated after it has been loaded.
- [Api.CreateInkAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateInkAnnot.md): Creates ink annotation.
- [Api.CreateJsAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateJsAction.md): Creates a js action.
- [Api.CreateLineAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateLineAnnot.md): Creates line annotation.
- [Api.CreateLinearGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateLinearGradientFill.md): Creates a linear gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected linear gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateLinkAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateLinkAnnot.md): Creates a link annotation.
- [Api.CreateListboxField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateListboxField.md): Creates a listbox field.
- [Api.CreateMath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateMath.md): Creates a math equation from a linear text string. The resulting object can be inserted into a paragraph the same way as a run (e.g. via ApiParagraph#AddElement or ApiParagraph#Push).
- [Api.CreateNamedAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateNamedAction.md): Creates a named action.
- [Api.CreateNoFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateNoFill.md): Creates no fill and removes the fill from the element.
- [Api.CreateNumbering](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateNumbering.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the numbering character or symbol specified with the numType parameter.
- [Api.CreateParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateParagraph.md): Creates a new paragraph.
- [Api.CreatePatternFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreatePatternFill.md): Creates a pattern fill to apply to the object using the selected pattern as the object background.
- [Api.CreatePolyLineAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreatePolyLineAnnot.md): Creates polyline annotation.
- [Api.CreatePolygonAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreatePolygonAnnot.md): Creates polygon annotation.
- [Api.CreatePresetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetColor.md): Creates a color selecting it from one of the available color presets.
- [Api.CreatePresetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetGeometry.md): Creates a geometry using one of the available preset shapes.
- [Api.CreateRGBColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRGBColor.md): Creates an RGB color setting the appropriate values for the red, green and blue color components.
- [Api.CreateRadialGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRadialGradientFill.md): Creates a radial gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected radial gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateRadiobuttonField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRadiobuttonField.md): Creates a radiobutton field.
- [Api.CreateRedactAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRedactAnnot.md): Creates redact annotation.
- [Api.CreateResetFormsAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateResetFormsAction.md): Creates a reset forms action.
- [Api.CreateRichParaPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRichParaPr.md): Creates the empty rich paragraph properties.
- [Api.CreateRichParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRichParagraph.md): Creates a new rich paragraph.
- [Api.CreateRichRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRichRun.md): Creates a new rich run.
- [Api.CreateRichTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRichTextPr.md): Creates the empty rich text properties.
- [Api.CreateRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateRun.md): Creates a new smaller text block to be inserted to the current paragraph or table.
- [Api.CreateSchemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateSchemeColor.md): Creates a complex color scheme selecting from one of the available schemes.
- [Api.CreateShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateShadow.md): Creates a shadow which can be applied to a graphic object.
- [Api.CreateShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateShape.md): Creates a shape with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateShd.md): Creates the shading which can be applied to text, a paragraph, a table or a table cell.
- [Api.CreateSignatureField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateSignatureField.md): Creates a signature field.
- [Api.CreateSolidFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateSolidFill.md): Creates a solid fill to apply to the object using a selected solid color as the object background.
- [Api.CreateSquareAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateSquareAnnot.md): Creates square annotation.
- [Api.CreateStampAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateStampAnnot.md): Creates stamp annotation.
- [Api.CreateStrikeoutAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateStrikeoutAnnot.md): Creates strikeout annotation.
- [Api.CreateStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateStroke.md): Creates a stroke adding shadows to the element.
- [Api.CreateTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateTable.md): Creates a table.
- [Api.CreateTableRowPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateTableRowPr.md): Creates the empty table row properties.
- [Api.CreateTextAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextAnnot.md): Creates text annotation.
- [Api.CreateTextField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextField.md): Creates a text field.
- [Api.CreateTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextPr.md): Creates the empty text properties.
- [Api.CreateUnderlineAnnot](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateUnderlineAnnot.md): Creates underline annotation.
- [Api.CreateUriAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/CreateUriAction.md): Creates an URI action.
- [Api.EmusToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/EmusToMillimeters.md): Converts English Metric Units (EMUs) to millimeters.
- [Api.EmusToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/EmusToPoints.md): Converts EMUs (English Metric Units) to points.
- [Api.GetByInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/GetByInternalId.md): Returns the object by it's internal ID.
- [Api.GetDocument](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/GetDocument.md): Creates a text field with the specified text field properties.
- [Api.GetFullName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/GetFullName.md): Returns the full name of the currently opened file.
- [Api.HexColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/HexColor.md): Creates a color from a HEX string.
- [Api.InchesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/InchesToPoints.md): Converts inches to points.
- [Api.LinesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/LinesToPoints.md): Converts lines to points (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.MergeShapes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/MergeShapes.md): Merges an array of drawings into new shapes. The resulting shapes take the formatting of the first drawing in the array.
- [Api.MillimetersToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToEmus.md): Converts millimeters to English Metric Units (EMUs).
- [Api.MillimetersToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPixels.md): Converts millimeters to pixels.
- [Api.MillimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPoints.md): Converts millimeters to points.
- [Api.PicasToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PicasToPoints.md): Converts picas to points.
- [Api.PixelsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToEmus.md): Converts pixels to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PixelsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToPoints.md): Converts pixels to points.
- [Api.PointsToCentimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToCentimeters.md): Converts points to centimeters.
- [Api.PointsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToEmus.md): Converts points to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PointsToInches](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToInches.md): Converts points to inches.
- [Api.PointsToLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToLines.md): Converts points to lines (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToMillimeters.md): Converts points to millimeters.
- [Api.PointsToPicas](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPicas.md): Converts points to picas (1 pica = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPixels.md): Converts points to pixels.
- [Api.PointsToTwips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/PointsToTwips.md): Converts points to twips.
- [Api.RGB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/RGB.md): Creates an RGB color from red, green and blue components.
- [Api.RGBA](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/RGBA.md): Creates an RGBA color from red, green, blue and alpha components.
- [Api.ThemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/ThemeColor.md): Creates a theme color.
- [Api.TwipsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/TwipsToPoints.md): Converts twips to points.
- [Api.attachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/attachEvent.md): Subscribes to the specified event and calls the callback function when the event fires.
- [Api.detachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Api/Methods/detachEvent.md): Unsubscribes from the specified event.

## ApiBaseAction

- [ApiBaseAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAction.md): Class representing a base pdf action.
- [ApiBaseAction.GetNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAction/Methods/GetNext.md): Returns next action.
- [ApiBaseAction.SetNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAction/Methods/SetNext.md): Sets next action.

## ApiBaseAnnotation

- [ApiBaseAnnotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation.md): Class representing a base annotation.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.AddReply](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/AddReply.md): Adds reply on this annot.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/Delete.md): Removes annotation from document.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetAuthorName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetAuthorName.md): Gets annotation author name.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetBorderColor.md): Gets annotation border color.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetBorderEffectIntensity](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetBorderEffectIntensity.md): Gets annotation border effect intensity.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetBorderEffectStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetBorderEffectStyle.md): Gets annotation border effect style.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetBorderStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetBorderStyle.md): Gets annotation border style.
- [ApiBaseAnnotation.GetBorderWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiBaseAnnotation/Methods/GetBorderWidth.md): Gets annotation border width.

OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.

- [ApiDocumentContent.GetElementsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetElementsCount.md): Returns a number of elements in the current document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the inner text of the current document content object.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetTextRange.md): Returns an ApiTextRange object that represents the part of the text contained in the current document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.Push](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/Push.md): Pushes a paragraph or a table to actually add it to the document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveAllElements](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveAllElements.md): Removes all the elements from the current document or from the current document element.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveElement.md): Removes an element using the position specified.
- [ApiDocumentContent.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all content of the current document content object with the specified text, preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.

- [ApiDrawing.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDrawing/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing. If another drawing with the same name already exists, that drawing's name will be reset to a default auto-generated name. OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.

- [ApiDrawing.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiDrawing/Methods/SetPosition.md): Sets the position of the drawing on the page.

- [ApiGroup.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiGroup/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing. If another drawing with the same name already exists, that drawing's name will be reset to a default auto-generated name. OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.

- [ApiImage.SetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetFlipV.md): Sets the vertical flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiImage.SetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiImage.SetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetLockAspect.md): Sets whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiImage.SetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetLockValue.md): Sets the lock value to the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiImage.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing. If another drawing with the same name already exists, that drawing's name will be reset to a default auto-generated name. OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.
- [ApiImage.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiImage.SetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetPosX.md): Sets the x position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiImage.SetPosY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetPosY.md): Sets the y position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiImage.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetPosition.md): Sets the position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiImage.SetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetRotation.md): Sets the rotation angle to the current drawing object.
- [ApiImage.SetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetShadow.md): Sets the shadow to the current graphic object.
- [ApiImage.SetSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetSize.md): Sets the size of the object (image, shape, chart) bounding box.
- [ApiImage.SetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/SetTitle.md): Sets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiImage.Unselect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiImage/Methods/Unselect.md): Removes the current graphic object from the selection.

- [ApiParagraph.MoveCursorToEnd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/MoveCursorToEnd.md): Moves the cursor to the end of the paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.MoveCursorToStart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/MoveCursorToStart.md): Moves the cursor to the start of the paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.Push](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/Push.md): Adds an element to the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.RemoveAllElements](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/RemoveAllElements.md): Removes all the elements from the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.RemoveElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/RemoveElement.md): Removes an element using the position specified.
- [ApiParagraph.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/Select.md): Selects the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetBold](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetBold.md): Sets the bold property to the text character.
- [ApiParagraph.SetBullet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetBullet.md): Sets the bullet or numbering to the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in this paragraph are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiParagraph.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiParagraph.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.
- [ApiParagraph.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetIndFirstLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetIndFirstLine.md): Sets the paragraph first line indentation.
- [ApiParagraph.SetIndLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetIndLeft.md): Sets the paragraph left side indentation.
- [ApiParagraph.SetIndRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetIndRight.md): Sets the paragraph right side indentation.
- [ApiParagraph.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiParagraph.SetJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetJc.md): Sets the paragraph contents justification.
- [ApiParagraph.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetOutlineLvl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetOutlineLvl.md): Sets the outline level for the specified properties.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in this paragraph are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSpacingAfter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSpacingAfter.md): Sets the spacing after the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSpacingBefore](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSpacingBefore.md): Sets the spacing before the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSpacingLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSpacingLine.md): Sets the paragraph line spacing.
- [ApiParagraph.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiParagraph.SetTabs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTabs.md): Specifies a sequence of custom tab stops which will be used for any tab characters in the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces the paragraph content with the specified text.
- [ApiParagraph.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the paragraph text properties.
- [ApiParagraph.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiParagraph.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiParagraph object into the JSON object.

## ApiPath

- [ApiPath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath.md): Class representing a path in geometry.
- [ApiPath.ArcTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/ArcTo.md): Draws an arc from the current point using the specified width and height radii, start angle, and sweep angle.
- [ApiPath.Close](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/Close.md): Closes the current path.
- [ApiPath.CubicBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/CubicBezTo.md): Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using two control points.
- [ApiPath.GetCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommand.md): Returns a specific path command by its index.
- [ApiPath.GetCommandCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommandCount.md): Returns the number of commands for the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetCommands](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommands.md): Returns all commands of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetFill.md): Returns the fill type of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetStroke.md): Returns true if the current path is stroked, otherwise false.
- [ApiPath.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current path.
- [ApiPath.LineTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/LineTo.md): Draws a line from the current point to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.MoveTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/MoveTo.md): Moves the current path to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.QuadBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/QuadBezTo.md): Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using a control point.
- [ApiPath.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill type to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the height to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetStroke.md): Sets whether the current path is stroked.
- [ApiPath.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetWidth.md): Sets the width to the current path.

- [ApiPathCommand.GetX2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX2.md): Returns the X coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.

- [ApiPathCommand.GetY1](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY1.md): Returns the Y coordinate of the second control point for the cubic Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetY2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY2.md): Returns the Y coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.

## ApiTable

- [ApiTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable.md): Class representing a table.
- [ApiTable.AddColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddColumn.md): Adds a new column to the end of the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddColumns](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddColumns.md): Adds the new columns to the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddElement.md): Adds a paragraph using its position in the cell.
- [ApiTable.AddRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddRow.md): Adds a new row to the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddRows.md): Adds the new rows to the current table.
- [ApiTable.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/Copy.md): Creates a copy of the current table.
- [ApiTable.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the specified drawing object from the parent.
- [ApiTable.Fill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/Fill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.GetCell](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetCell.md): Returns a cell by its position.
- [ApiTable.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the type of the ApiTable object.
- [ApiTable.GetColumnWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetColumnWidth.md): Returns the width of the specified column (by index) of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetColumnsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetColumnsCount.md): Returns a number of columns in the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetDescription.md): Gets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetFill.md): Gets the fill formatting properties from the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.GetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetFlipH.md): Get horizontal flip of current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetFlipV.md): Get vertical flip of current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetLine.md): Gets the outline properties from the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.GetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetLockAspect.md): Returns whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiTable.GetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetLockValue.md): Returns the lock value for the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetName.md): Returns the name of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetParentPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetParentPage.md): Returns the type of the ApiDrawing class.
- [ApiTable.GetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetPosX.md): Gets the x position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiTable.GetPosY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetPosY.md): Gets the y position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiTable.GetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRotation.md): Returns the rotation angle of the current drawing object.
- [ApiTable.GetRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRow.md): Returns a row by its index.
- [ApiTable.GetRowsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRowsCount.md): Returns a number of rows in the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedCells.md): Returns the selected cells of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedColumnsCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedColumnsCells.md): Returns all cells from the columns that contain the currently selected cells. This method identifies which columns contain selected cells and then returns all cells in those columns, not just the selected cells themselves.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedRows.md): Returns the rows that contain the currently selected cells of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetShadow.md): Returns the shadow of the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.GetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableDescription.md): Returns the table description.
- [ApiTable.GetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableLook.md): Gets table look properties
- [ApiTable.GetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableTitle.md): Returns the table title.
- [ApiTable.GetTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTextRange.md): Returns a text range that covers the whole text of the current drawing. Creates a text body if the drawing does not yet have one.
- [ApiTable.GetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTitle.md): Gets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.HasTextContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/HasTextContent.md): Checks whether the current drawing has a text body.
- [ApiTable.MergeCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/MergeCells.md): Merges an array of cells.
- [ApiTable.RemoveColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveColumn.md): Removes a table column with the specified cell.
- [ApiTable.RemoveRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveRow.md): Removes a table row with the specified cell.
- [ApiTable.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/Select.md): Selects the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SelectRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SelectRange.md): Selects a range of cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color for all cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetColumnWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetColumnWidth.md): Sets the width of the specified column in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetDescription.md): Sets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFlipH.md): Sets the horizontal flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFlipV.md): Sets the vertical flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the total height of the current table, distributing it evenly among the table rows. The value is applied as a minimum height for each row, so a row can be taller if its content requires more space.
- [ApiTable.SetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLockAspect.md): Sets whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiTable.SetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLockValue.md): Sets the lock value to the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing. If another drawing with the same name already exists, that drawing's name will be reset to a default auto-generated name. OLE objects do not support a custom name, so for them this method always returns false.
- [ApiTable.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosX.md): Sets the x position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiTable.SetPosY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosY.md): Sets the y position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiTable.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosition.md): Sets the position of the drawing on the page.
- [ApiTable.SetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetRotation.md): Sets the rotation angle to the current drawing object.
- [ApiTable.SetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetShadow.md): Sets the shadow to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading which shall be applied to the extents of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetSize.md): Sets the table size.
- [ApiTable.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetStyle.md): Sets the style for the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableDescription.md): Sets the table description.
- [ApiTable.SetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableLook.md): Specifies the components of the conditional formatting of the referenced table style (if one exists) which shall be applied to the set of table rows with the current table-level property exceptions. A table style can specify up to six different optional conditional formats [Example: Different formatting for first column], which then can be applied or omitted from individual table rows in the parent table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableTitle.md): Sets the table title.
- [ApiTable.SetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTitle.md): Sets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.Unselect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTable/Methods/Unselect.md): Removes the current graphic object from the selection.

## ApiTableCell

- [ApiTableCell.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color of the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderBottom.md): Sets the border which shall be displayed at the bottom of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderLeft.md): Sets the border which shall be displayed at the left of the current table cell.

- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderTop.md): Sets the border which shall be displayed at the top of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginBottom.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the bottom extent of the cell contents and the border of a specific individual table cell within a table.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginLeft.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the left extent of the current cell contents and the left edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginRight.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the right extent of the current cell contents and the right edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginTop.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the top extent of the current cell contents and the top edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.
- [ApiTableCell.SetColumnBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetColumnBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to all cells in the column containing the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading which shall be applied to the extents of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all content of the current table cell with the specified text, preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.
- [ApiTableCell.SetTextDirection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetTextDirection.md): Specifies the direction of the text flow for the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the content of the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetVerticalAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetVerticalAlign.md): Specifies the vertical alignment for text within the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetWidth.md): Specifies the preferred width for this cell.

- [ApiTextPr.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiTextPr.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.

- [ApiTextPr.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the text outline to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextPr.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiTextPr.SetTextFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetTextFill.md): Sets the text fill to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextPr.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of the run in relation to the default appearance of the run text:

## ApiTextRange

- [ApiTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange.md): Class representing a text range within a presentation shape's text frame.
- [ApiTextRange.AddHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddHyperlink.md): Adds a hyperlink to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddText.md): Adds a text to the specified position. The current range is expanded to include the added text.
- [ApiTextRange.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.ExpandTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ExpandTo.md): Returns a new range that spans both this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.Find](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Find.md): Finds the first occurrence of the given text within this range and returns it as a new ApiTextRange. Returns null if the text is not found.
- [ApiTextRange.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns all Paragraph objects within this range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the class type identifier.
- [ApiTextRange.GetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetEndPos.md): Returns the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetParagraph.md): Returns the paragraph at the given index within this range. Returns null if the index is out of bounds.
- [ApiTextRange.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns a new ApiTextRange that represents a sub-range of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetStartPos.md): Returns the start position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text content of the range. Paragraph breaks are represented as "\r".
- [ApiTextRange.GetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetTextPr.md): Returns the merged text properties of the entire range.
- [ApiTextRange.IntersectWith](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/IntersectWith.md): Returns a new range that is the intersection of this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.MoveCursorToPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/MoveCursorToPos.md): Moves a cursor to the specified position within the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.Replace](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Replace.md): Replaces all occurrences of the specified text within this range.
- [ApiTextRange.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Select.md): Selects the text range in the editor.
- [ApiTextRange.SetBold](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetBold.md): Sets bold formatting for the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiTextRange.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiTextRange.SetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetEndPos.md): Sets the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets the font family for the current TextRange.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size of the characters in the current text Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiTextRange.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStartPos.md): Sets the start position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.
- [ApiTextRange.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all text content with the given string. Use "\r" to separate paragraphs.
- [ApiTextRange.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextRange.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text: "baseline" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned by the default text baseline. "subscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned below the default text baseline. "superscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned above the default text baseline.
- [ApiTextRange.ToHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ToHtml.md): Converts the text range to HTML.

- [SearchProps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/SearchProps.md): Search options used when performing text search operations.
- [SearchResults](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/SearchResults.md): Represents a collection of search results.
- [ShadowSettings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/ShadowSettings.md): Properties used to create a shadow.
- [ShapeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/ShapeType.md): This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.
- [ShapesMergeOperation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/ShapesMergeOperation.md): The operation used to merge shapes.
- [ShdType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/ShdType.md): A shade type which can be added to the document element.
- [StampType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/StampType.md): The available stamp types.
- [TabJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TabJc.md): Custom tab types.
- [TabStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TabStop.md): A paragraph tab stop.
- [TableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TableLook.md): No description provided.
- [TableWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TableWidth.md): The possible values for the units of the width property are defined by a specific table or table cell width property.
- [TextFitType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TextFitType.md): The available text autofit types inside a shape.
- [TextFlowDirection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TextFlowDirection.md): The available text direction inside a drawing content.
- [TextIconType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TextIconType.md): The available text annot icon types.
- [TextVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TextVertAlign.md): The available vertical text alignment.
- [TextWithQuads](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TextWithQuads.md): Represents a text with it's quad
- [TickLabelPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TickLabelPosition.md): Possible values for the position of chart tick labels (either horizontal or vertical).
- [TickMark](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TickMark.md): The type of tick mark appearance.
- [TimeFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/TimeFormat.md): Time format options:
- [ToHtmlOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/ToHtmlOptions.md): Options for converting document content to an HTML string.
- [VerticalTextAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/VerticalTextAlign.md): The available text vertical alignment (used to align text in a shape with a placement for text inside it).
- [WidgetBorderStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/WidgetBorderStyle.md): The available widget border styles.
- [WidgetBorderWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/WidgetBorderWidth.md): The available widget border width.
- [WidgetTextAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/WidgetTextAlign.md): The available widget text alignments.
- [byte](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/byte.md): A numeric value from 0 to 255.
- [highlightColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/highlightColor.md): Available highlight colors.
- [hps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/hps.md): Half-points (2 half-points = 1 point).
- [line240](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/line240.md): 240ths of a line.
- [mm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/mm.md): 1 millimetre equals 1/10th of a centimetre.
- [percentage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/percentage.md): Value from 0 to 100.
- [pt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/pt.md): A point.
- [twips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/Enumeration/twips.md): Twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch).

## PdfFile

- [PdfFile](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/PdfFile.md): Class representing a pdf file in binary format.
- [PdfFile.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/PdfFile/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the PdfFile class.
- [PdfFile.ToBase64](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/pdf-api/PdfFile/Methods/ToBase64.md): Returns pdf file in base64 format.
